angle: It goes with everything, and works for everything, without being overthought.
pipeline: gpt-image-2-image-to-image (keyframes) -> kling-3.0/video (i2v) -> ElevenLabs single-track VO -> stitch
product_lock: The bag is the exact Velantra Straw Tote from the first product reference image and every color matches that first reference image exactly: a structured hand woven straw tote in warm sandy caramel, tightly woven straw body with braided cross stitch trim along the edges, a smooth taupe leather flap folded over the top of the bag from the back: the flap is ONE single seamless piece of leather, its front lower edge cut into the silhouette of a wide center panel with 2 squared outer tabs, the leather fully continuous and unbroken between and above these shapes, with exactly 2 narrow slots through which the handles pass, two rolled taupe leather top handles, two taupe leather belt straps crossed on the front, white contrast stitching on all leather edges, no metal hardware, no logos. The leather flap, tabs and belt straps exist ONLY on the FRONT face of the bag, the back face is plain woven straw, no duplicated front detailing on any other face. The bag has ONLY the two rolled top handles, it has no shoulder strap and no crossbody strap of any kind, never add one. Keep the bag identical to the reference image, no added logos, no added hardware, no added straps.
flap_closed_pin: Flap construction: the taupe leather flap is ONE single seamless sheet of leather attached along the top rear edge of the tote and folded all the way forward over the front, lying completely flat and fully closed. The leather runs continuously and unbroken across the ENTIRE top of the bag from the far left edge to the far right edge, forming one uninterrupted top band with a single stitch line. Its front LOWER edge is cut into the shape of a wide center panel and 2 squared outer tabs, but these are shapes cut into the SAME single sheet, never separate applied panels, and they never each have their own finished top edge. The notches between those shapes start low, roughly halfway up the flap, and the leather bridges solidly above them, exactly as on the reference bag. No vertical gap ever reaches the top edge of the flap. The 2 narrow handle slots begin below the top edge and never break it. The only openings anywhere in the flap are those 2 handle slots. No gap, no seam, no split and no opening exists anywhere else in the flap, and nothing inside the bag is ever visible through the flap. The flap never splits into pieces, never lifts, never stands up, always folded all the way over. Nothing protrudes from the flap's lower edge: no nub, stud, tab, fastener or catch of any kind. HANDLES: the 2 rolled taupe leather top handles rise as two separate clean loops, one on the left and one on the right, well apart from each other, each passing through its own narrow slot. They never collapse flat onto the flap, never bunch or fold together into a mass, never form a puffy blob over the center panel, and are never wrapped, looped or threaded around any strap, buckle or other element. The 2 taupe leather belt straps lie crossed in an X over the front below the flap with rounded ends and white contrast stitching, exactly as on the closed reference bag. No metal hardware anywhere on the bag.
flap_open_pin: Flap construction, and how something goes into the bag: the taupe leather flap is ONE single seamless sheet of leather attached along the top REAR edge of the tote and folded ALL THE WAY OVER the whole bag, forward across the top and down the front, lying completely flat against the front face. The fold at the top of the flap IS the highest point and the top edge of the entire bag. NOTHING stands above the flap: no straw wall, no woven side walls rising past it, no open box of straw, no visible interior. The bag therefore reads as CLOSED even while something is being put into it. The leather runs continuously and unbroken across the ENTIRE top of the bag from the far left edge to the far right edge, forming one uninterrupted top band. Its front LOWER edge is cut into the shape of a wide center panel and 2 squared outer tabs, but these are shapes cut into the SAME single sheet, never separate applied panels. The notches between those shapes start low, roughly halfway up the flap, and the leather bridges solidly above them. No vertical gap ever reaches the top edge. The only openings anywhere in the flap are the 2 narrow handle slots, which begin below the top edge. Nothing protrudes from the flap's lower edge: no nub, stud, tab or fastener. Anything being put into the bag is slipped in BEHIND the flap at the rear: the object and the fingertips holding it simply disappear behind the flap's folded top edge, hidden by the leather. The object is never seen inside the bag, never seen through the flap, never rests on top of the flap, and the interior of the bag is never visible. HANDLES: the 2 rolled taupe leather top handles rise as two separate clean upright loops, one on the left and one on the right, well apart from each other, each passing through its own narrow slot. The handles never collapse flat onto the flap, never bunch or fold together into a mass, never form a puffy blob over the center panel, and are never wrapped, looped or threaded around any strap, buckle or other element. The 2 taupe leather belt straps lie crossed in an X over the front below the flap with rounded ends and white contrast stitching, never threaded through the flap and never wrapped around the handles. No metal hardware anywhere on the bag.
kling_flap_pin: The leather flap stays ONE single seamless sheet folded all the way over, lying completely flat the entire clip: no gap, seam, or split ever opens anywhere in it, nothing behind it ever shows through it, and its cut edge shapes never separate into pieces. The two leather belt straps stay crossed in an X on the front the whole clip and never merge into one horizontal strap. No buckle, turn lock, clasp, stud, ring or metal fitting of any kind ever appears anywhere on the bag, and no shoulder strap ever appears.
style_line: Candid iPhone photo look shot in hard bright midday summer sun with crisp directional shadows, sun drenched coastal town, realistic skin texture, natural light, true to life color, subtle sensor grain, vertical 9:16 framing. The leather is a clean unmarked warm tan taupe with no smudges, blotches, stains or discolored patches anywhere on it, and the straw is evenly woven with no smeared or flattened patches. The bag silhouette is clean against the background with no stray bright highlights, spikes or fragments protruding from any edge, and no pale flat ghost shapes overlaying the bag. Absolutely no text, captions, watermarks, logos, graphics, sparkles, stars or corner glyphs anywhere in the image.
imperfections_human: Subtle inconsistent handheld micro jitter, slight rolling shutter wobble during motion, natural eye focus drift, background movement continues even when the subject is still. No text or captions on screen.
imperfections_product: Subtle inconsistent handheld micro jitter, slight rolling shutter wobble during motion, ambient light keeps shifting gently even when the bag is still. No text or captions on screen.

script.vo: From beach mornings to market runs,
lunch on the water to dinner in town,
it goes with everything without feeling overthought.
It's hand woven, with a structured body and leather detailing,
so it holds its shape, and a whole day of stuff.
It's the one you'll keep reaching for, all summer long.

shots.subject: human
shots.ref_beat: ref frame 1 - seated, slipping sunglasses in behind the flap
shots.keyframe_prompt: Shot of a woman seated on a sunlit white slatted bench, framed from her collarbone down to her knees so her face is completely out of frame. She wears a black ribbed tank top and white linen shorts. The caramel straw tote stands upright on her lap facing the camera and looks exactly like the closed product reference photo: the smooth leather flap folded all the way over the whole bag and lying flat down the front, the two belt straps crossed in an X below it, the two rolled leather handles standing in two separate loops. Her hand comes down from above behind the bag and slips a pair of black sunglasses in behind the flap, so her fingertips and most of the sunglasses have already disappeared behind the flap's folded top edge and only the very end of one arm of the sunglasses is still showing above the leather. The bag is not open, nothing of its interior can be seen, and no straw stands above the leather flap.
shots.motion_prompt: Her hand slides the sunglasses the rest of the way down behind the leather flap until they disappear from view, then lifts away empty, while the bag, its flat flap and its two upright handles stay completely still.

She wears a black linen halter top and wide black trousers with black rectangular sunglasses. The caramel straw tote hangs closed from one hand at her side.
shots.motion_prompt: She shifts her weight from one hip to the other and the bag swings gently at her side, then she turns her head slightly toward the light.

shots.motion_prompt: The camera drifts down with her stride as the bag sways against her hip and the palm shadow slides across the pavement beneath her.
